function.arguments: {"finding": "The 'channel' variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (specifically, 'loyal' and 'returning' segments). The cross-tabulation shows that email has a much higher proportion of loyal customers (141/359 ≈ 39.3%) compared to paid_search (29/541 ≈ 5.4%). This creates a confounding factor: the higher conversion rate in email is likely due to customer segment, not the campaign itself.", "implication": "A direct comparison of conversion rates between channels is confounded. function.name: note_finding
